name: dsdv_eng_tap_w-etapw_m-COMMIT
purpose: S81 G8IQ stand-in master dsdv_eng_tap_w (1 inst, Engram west-end tap) to closure: TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native census 32 -> S81-DIE9 G9 bind

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsdv_eng_tap_w u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay_bounded32.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/eng/dsdv_eng_rr.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsdv_eng_tap_w/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsdv_eng_tap_w/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsdv_eng_tap_w --out {RUN}/record/views/dsdv_eng_tap_w  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: TOK-FUNC2-ENG_TAP_W 10-21: kit of the G8IQ stand-in master dsdv_eng_tap_w (u_etap_00, west end of the Engram request/response chains: no rco / pci ports) on the shared SAFE core successor 3f93b69ab (TOK-FUNC2-ENG_TAP: kept-hierarchy native32 slices, bounded32 reset, cycle-identical, same ports/edges/faults). MAIN: same outline / face plan as the 15 middle taps (dsdv_eng_tap MAIN 138.24 x 86.4: reader N, controller S, chain E; W empty = chain end) so the 16-tap row is uniform for G9.
